## How this section is organized
1) **Foundations**: definitions + units of analysis + measurement caveats  
2) **Mechanisms**: theory families (channels)  
3) **Institutions**: policing/courts/corrections as strategic systems  
4) **Topics**: substantive crime domains  
5) **Models**: canonical strategic/dynamic representations
